boxferry.caller:
---
on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group: null
jobs:
  lockfile-release-age:
    name: Dependency eligibility
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      statuses: read
    # Reviewed immutable bootstrap infrastructure; no automation release exists yet.
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-dependency-wait.yml@ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}

  pr-gate:
    name: Required CI
    if: always()
    needs:
      [
        validation-plan,
        canonical-artifact-integrity,
        kubernetes-artifact-integrity,
        compose-provider-integrity,
        automation,
        release-binaries,
        rust,
        msrv,
        dependencies,
        documentation,
        release-metadata,
        semver-release-type,
        semver,
        coverage,
        migration-readiness,
        lockfile-release-age,
      ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      candidate_sha: ${{ steps.result.outputs.candidate_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact tested revision and comparison history
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out independently trusted policy
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          path: .validation-base
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install locked shared Python tools
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Require every selected job to succeed and every skip to be planned
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
          PLAN_JSON: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.plan }}
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ -f .validation-base/scripts/shared-validation-policy.json ]]; then
            uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci gate \
                --repository-root "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}" --config .validation-base/scripts/shared-validation-policy.json \
                --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
                --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" --plan-json "${PLAN_JSON}" --needs-json "${NEEDS_JSON}"
          else
            python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          import re

          jobs = ['canonical-artifact-integrity', 'kubernetes-artifact-integrity', 'compose-provider-integrity', 'automation', 'release-binaries', 'rust', 'msrv', 'dependencies', 'documentation', 'release-metadata', 'semver-release-type', 'semver', 'coverage', 'migration-readiness', 'lockfile-release-age']
          event = os.environ["EVENT_NAME"]
          base, head, tested = (os.environ[key] for key in ("BASE_SHA", "HEAD_SHA", "GITHUB_SHA"))
          if event not in {"pull_request", "merge_group", "push", "workflow_dispatch"} or any(not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", value) for value in (base, head, tested)):
              raise SystemExit("bootstrap comparison is malformed")
          plan = {"schema": 3, "repository": "Strukturpiloten/boxferry", "event": event,
                  "base_sha": base, "head_sha": head, "tested_sha": tested, "profile": "full",
                  "profiles": ["full"], "jobs": {job: True for job in jobs},
                  "reasons": ["trusted base has no adopted policy"], "local_fingerprint": None}
          actual = json.loads(os.environ["PLAN_JSON"])
          needs = json.loads(os.environ["NEEDS_JSON"])
          if actual != plan or set(needs) != {"validation-plan", *jobs}:
              raise SystemExit("first-rollout complete validation contract is inconsistent")
          for job in ("validation-plan", *jobs):
              if needs[job].get("result") != "success":
                  raise SystemExit(f"first-rollout required job {job} did not succeed")
          print("First-rollout complete validation: every required job succeeded")
          PY
          fi
      - name: Bind successful candidate
        id: result
        env:
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: printf 'candidate_sha=%s\n' "${CANDIDATE_SHA}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

---
on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group: null
jobs:
  lockfile-release-age:
    name: Dependency eligibility
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      statuses: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-dependency-wait.yml@ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}

  check-gate:
    name: Required CI
    if: always() && !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main')
    needs: [validation-plan, rust, msrv, dependencies, api, documentation, lockfile-release-age, native-conformance]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind exact candidate and trusted policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Require selected jobs and only intentional skips
        id: offline
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
          POLICY_CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          PLAN_JSON: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.plan }}
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          NEEDS_JSON="$(python3 -c 'import json, os; needs = json.loads(os.environ["NEEDS_JSON"]); needs.pop("native-conformance"); print(json.dumps(needs))')"
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci gate \
            --repository-root source --config "${POLICY_CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --plan-json "${PLAN_JSON}" --needs-json "${NEEDS_JSON}"
      - name: Fail on skipped, cancelled, or failed validation
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          EVENT_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          SCAFFOLD_RESULT: ${{ steps.offline.outcome }}
          NATIVE_RESULT: ${{ needs.native-conformance.result }}
        run: |
          test "$SCAFFOLD_RESULT" = success
          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == pull_request || "$EVENT_NAME" == merge_group ]]; then
            test "$NATIVE_RESULT" = skipped
            echo 'PR and queue validation is offline-only; native Engine evidence is not claimed'
          elif [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == push && "$EVENT_REF" == refs/heads/main ]]; then
            test "$NATIVE_RESULT" = success
          else
            echo 'unexpected validation event; native evidence is required' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
